chapters.title: Chapter 14: Landmark Fair Use Precedents—Campbell, Authors Guild, Cariou, TCA, and Hachette
chapters.reason: This chapter directly teaches the controlling holdings and doctrinal language from the listed fair-use precedents (Campbell, Authors Guild, Cariou, TCA, Hachette). Verbatim excerpts are necessary so students can analyze the courts' formulations of "transformative" purpose, parody doctrine, pleading- and summary-stage reasoning, and the factor-four market/usurpation framework.

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Landmark New York Fraud Damages—Lama Holding and Progeny
chapters.reason: The chapter centers on Lama Holding's authoritative rule on fraud damages (out-of-pocket measure). Including that opinion's key passages is important for accurately presenting the Court of Appeals' holdings, phrasing of the damages rule, and its application to pleading and proof.
